title: E-Commerce (Cartivo)
desc: Mobile-first bilingual (Arabic / English, full RTL) storefront with search, filters and sorting kept in the URL, cart, optimistic wishlist, and checkout by Stripe card or cash on delivery. Secure NextAuth sessions, Server Actions for every mutation, ISR-cached pages, and SEO with sitemap and product structured data.

title: Socialix
desc: Social network app with a cached post feed, post composer with images and emoji, nested comments and replies, likes, saved posts, notifications, user suggestions, and profile settings. Protected routes, light / dark theme, and unit-tested API helpers.

title: Limby Fit
desc: Nutrition coaching platform for coaches and trainees: manage trainees, generate diet plans from a food database, track progress with charts, and export plans as PDF. Separate coach and trainee portals with Firebase cloud sync, Arabic UI, and installable PWA manifest.

title: PS5 Hub
desc: Gaming lounge website with game detail modals, a menu cart, table reservation form, animated stat counters, 3D tilt cards, a canvas particle background, and a light / dark theme toggle.

title: Nebula Music Player
desc: Glassmorphism music player with iTunes track search, a persistent library that keeps your own MP3 files in IndexedDB, liked tracks, an animated audio visualizer, and Google sign-in through Firebase.

title: Weather App
desc: Weather dashboard that detects your location, shows current conditions and a 3-day forecast with a temperature chart, and pins the city on an interactive map.

title: FlowList To-Do
desc: Task manager with add, edit, and delete, status filters, confetti when you finish tasks, a dark mode, and tasks saved in LocalStorage.
